data.reasoning: The only complete, non-advisory report (deepseek-v4-flash) found the PKGBUILD to be a standard Rust application build with no malicious indicators. data.disagreement_analysis: The apparent disagreement was between tool failures and a successful analysis. coverage_issues: qwen3-235b-a22b-2507: API errors (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) prevented review of PKGBUILD and LICENSE files
openrouter/free: LLMResponseError prevented review of LICENSE file
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, LLM response errors) should trigger automatic retry or fallback to prevent inconclusive verdicts when the package itself may be safe
Advisory reports should be excluded from verdict calculation entirely, not just downweighted, to avoid confusion in disagreement detection
When multiple reports fail with tool errors on the same files, the audit system should recognize this as a systemic issue rather than treating each failure independently
